confirmation.paymentDescription: You are about to record the payment below. Check the amount received, periods and payment method before continuing.
confirmation.paymentConsequence: Confirming records this payment against the listed periods. Continue only after checking the funds received.
confirmation.deleteDescription: Please confirm that you want to delete the record identified below.
confirmation.deleteCustomerNote: Deletion may affect associated payments and documents. This is not contract cancellation. Prefer retaining the record and changing its status to preserve history.
confirmation.deleteUserNote: This removes the user account. To block access, prefer deactivating the account to preserve historical attribution.
confirmation.deleteReceiptNote: The receipt will be removed. This does not annul the payment or restore debt. Financial documents require an auditable annulment process.
confirmation.deletePaymentNote: The payment and associated documents may be removed. Deletion is not an auditable annulment and debt restoration depends on the data service in use. Check the records before proceeding.
confirmation.saveCustomerDescription: Check the customer details and account conditions before saving.
confirmation.saveUserDescription: Check the account holder, access role and account status before saving. These settings determine access to the system.
confirmation.generateDescription: This requests monthly charge generation. Check the period and existing records before proceeding.

dataTools.title: Data and backups
dataTools.localMode: Local mode · data in this browser
dataTools.localNote: The TXT supplies initial data. Changes stay in this browser; export a copy before changing computers. Import requires confirmation and signs you out.
dataTools.cloudNote: Writes are confirmed by the server. Backups contain sensitive data: keep them in a protected location.
dataTools.failed: The operation could not be confirmed. Previous data was preserved.
dataTools.corrupt: Data could not be read. Export the original for recovery.
dataTools.invalid: Invalid or incompatible backup. Local data was not replaced.
dataTools.importNote: An exact copy of the current state will be preserved in this browser first. Also export it to a file. This affects only this browser and signs you out.
dataTools.snapshotNote: Create a private copy of the current data version.
dataTools.springNote: Contact Spring and wait for backup integrity confirmation. Starting the server may take time.
dataTools.testSourceNote: Replace only the cloud test dataset with an anonymized copy and download it. Production and local browsers are unchanged.
